description: Fixture (ACCDB): small separate tables each prepared for one mutation family. Fx (ten rows, fixed Byte, Long, Currency, Date, GUID, Decimal and a trailing Text; row 8 Null in all fixed fields), Pg (12 rows of eight Text fields of 61 U+20AC), Mm (eight rows, memos of Null, 1000, 3000, 12000 and 20 characters and three of 1000), Lo (Long Binary of Null, 4076, 4090 and three of 100 bytes), Dr (20 small rows), IxM (602 Long keys with a gap at 302), IxD (300 rows with one duplicated indexed value), IxT (60 long unique Text keys), Au1..Au4 (AutoNumber tables: intact, tail deleted, middle deleted, all deleted) and the Nums helper. Created by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE Nums (K LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Nums PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 1 FROM Nums

CREATE TABLE Pg (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Pg PRIMARY KEY, T1 TEXT(255), T2 TEXT(255), T3 TEXT(255), T4 TEXT(255), T5 TEXT(255), T6 TEXT(255), T7 TEXT(255), T8 TEXT(255))
CREATE TABLE Mm (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Mm PRIMARY KEY, M MEMO)
CREATE TABLE Lo (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Lo PRIMARY KEY, O LONGBINARY)
CREATE TABLE Dr (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Dr PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, Vt TEXT(60))
INSERT INTO Dr (ID, A, Vt) SELECT K, K * 10, 'original text of row ' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 20
CREATE TABLE IxM (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_IxM PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO IxM (ID) SELECT K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 603 AND K <> 302
CREATE TABLE IxD (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_IxD PRIMARY KEY, G LONG)
INSERT INTO IxD (ID, G) SELECT K, 7 FROM Nums WHERE K <= 300
CREATE TABLE IxT (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_IxT PRIMARY KEY, W TEXT(60))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_IxT_W ON IxT (W)
INSERT INTO IxT (ID, W) SELECT K, 'k' & Format(K * 10, '0000') & 'pppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppp' FROM Nums WHERE K <= 60
CREATE TABLE Fx (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Fx PRIMARY KEY, Fb BYTE, Fl LONG, Fc CURRENCY, Ft DATETIME, Fg GUID, Vt TEXT(30))
INSERT INTO Fx (ID, Fb, Fl, Fc, Ft, Vt) SELECT K, K * 10, K * 1000, CCur(K * 1.25), #1/1/2000#, 'v' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 10
UPDATE Fx SET Fb = Null, Fl = Null, Fc = Null, Ft = Null WHERE ID = 8
UPDATE Fx SET Fm = ID * 100 WHERE ID <> 8
CREATE TABLE Au1 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Au1 PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO Au1 (S) SELECT 'row' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 10
CREATE TABLE Au2 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Au2 PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO Au2 (S) SELECT 'row' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 10
CREATE TABLE Au3 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Au3 PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO Au3 (S) SELECT 'row' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 10
CREATE TABLE Au4 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Au4 PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO Au4 (S) SELECT 'row' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 10
